title: A Breakdown of 6 Coffee Ads (And Why They Work) - Fresh Cup

facts.fact: William Uckers notes that one of the first coffee advertisements was a 1587 manuscript by Abd al-Kadir titled "Argument in Favor of the Legitimate Use of Coffee."
facts.quote: William Uckers notes that one of the first coffee advertisements was a 1587 manuscript by Abd al-Kadir titled “Argument in Favor of the Legitimate Use of Coffee.”

facts.fact: In 1652, Pasqua Rosée printed the first English-language coffee advertisement in a handbill for the coffee house he owned in London.
facts.quote: In 1652, Pasqua Rosée printed the first English-language coffee advertisement in a handbill for the coffee house he owned in London.

facts.fact: A vintage sign for Freihofer Baking Company's ground coffee delivery service dates from the 1930s.
facts.quote: Take this vintage sign for Freihofer Baking Company’s ground coffee delivery service from the 1930s:

facts.fact: Partners Coffee offers newsletter subscribers access to free brewing resources and support from coffee experts, plus a 10% off coupon.
facts.quote: They’ve also added a 10% off coupon to sweeten the deal.

facts.fact: Nguyen Coffee Supply's ad link copy reads "Sold Out 4X Already!", indicating its coffee has sold out four times.
facts.quote: the link copy—” Sold Out 4X Already!”—is responsible for creating a sense of urgency.

facts.fact: According to the article, "100% Arabica" means only that the product doesn't contain robusta beans.
facts.quote: All this means is that the product doesn’t contain robusta beans, but somewhere along the line, customers began to believe this phrase was a standard of communicating “quality.”

facts.fact: The article was published on June 9, 2022.
Fresh Cup's newsletter promotion says it is joined by more than 14,000 coffee leaders who receive top stories, deals, and industry news weekly.
facts.quote: **Join 14,000+ coffee leaders** and get top stories, deals, and other industry goodies in your inbox each week.

facts.fact: An article teaser says four coffee caterers' pricing methods were checked against pricing data from 25,860 bookings.
facts.quote: Four coffee caterers explain how they quote events, with their methods checked against pricing data from 25,860 bookings.

facts.fact: An article teaser says more than 40 roasters shared how they set wholesale coffee prices.
facts.quote: More than 40 roasters shared how they set wholesale coffee prices.

facts.fact: A Fresh Cup article teaser says its survey covered 40+ roasters on wholesale coffee charges, how they feel about those prices, and plans to raise prices in 2027.
facts.quote: We surveyed 40+ roasters on what they charge for wholesale coffee, how they feel about those prices, and whether they plan to raise prices in 2027.
